title: Niche
description: Contains a variety of niche functionality that may or may not be useful
body:
Contains some niche functionality that may or may not be useful.


FUNCTIONALITY
Indestructible Glass:
Makes any block close to a glass block (1 block close) unable to be destroyed by any explosion

Diamond Ore Removal:
Makes it so players can't mine diamond ore on certain worlds

Level Cap:
Limits the players XP level to a specific number


Sandstone into sand:
4 sandstone equals 2 sand

Clear Effects:
Clears effects on world switch

Texture Command:
Sends the player the texture pack url


Ping Command:
Sends the player their ping

Ping Player:
Allows the player to ping others via @ e.g. [USER=391639]@Optic_Fusion1[/USER]

Disable Item Material Drop:
Allows you to disable the ability for players to drop specific item materials e.g. A diamond pickaxe

Fix Command:
Teleports the player to themselves

Lock Block Interaction:
Gives you the ability to lock interacting with certain blocks behind a permission
